title: PREFERENCES
description: Display, navigation, Syndicate lineup and manual review preferences saved on this device.

active.label: ACTIVE
active.meaning: The module is operational in the terminal now.

display_only.label: DISPLAY ONLY
display_only.meaning: The module is fully presented in F6 but is intentionally not changeable from the terminal.

reserved.label: RESERVED
reserved.meaning: The module has a permanent home in F6 but its controls are not activated yet.

modules.title: Meter style
modules.summary: Choose how the VigScope meters are displayed.
modules.controlPolicy: Presentation only. Changing meter style does not alter Market Heat, Price Pressure, Market Agreement or Vig Scope state.

modules.title: Card style
modules.summary: Choose the appearance of individual Betting Edge cards.
modules.controlPolicy: Presentation only. Normal remains the product default. All four card views use the same recommendation data, geometry and game-status placement and do not change the master Vig Scope panel.

modules.title: Meat Desk review
modules.summary: Choose the depth for your next manual source review.
modules.controlPolicy: Applies only when a Meat Desk review is manually triggered. BASIC captures the core read-through and usable notes; IN-DEPTH publishes a detailed report with structured source intelligence; GOD MODE performs the full-source, page-referenced review and deepest publication pass. No mode auto-starts analysis or changes Betting Edge recommendation logic.

modules.title: Crypto Specials review
modules.summary: Choose the depth for your next manual web-source review.
modules.controlPolicy: Applies only when a Crypto Specials web-source review is manually triggered. BASIC captures the core page and usable notes; IN-DEPTH publishes a detailed report with structured source intelligence; GOD MODE performs the deepest page/context review and publication pass. No mode auto-starts analysis or changes Betting Edge recommendation logic.

modules.title: Saved lineup
modules.summary: Choose a member or leave a slot empty. Each member can appear once.
modules.controlPolicy: Local UI preference. Character content and archived hotlines are unchanged.

modules.title: Hotline appearance
modules.summary: The current approved design for each Syndicate member.
modules.controlPolicy: Repository-controlled presentation registry. Normal Hotline refreshes preserve the active approved shell. Shell installation, purchasing and switching are not enabled from F6 yet.

modules.title: Startup screen
modules.summary: Choose the view to use when VigScope opens.
modules.controlPolicy: Applies on the next runner load. It does not change report generation.

modules.title: History landing page
modules.summary: Choose which Bet History page opens first.
modules.controlPolicy: Navigation preference only. History data, grading and archived records are unchanged.

modules.title: Recommendation details
modules.summary: Choose whether recommendation analysis starts open or closed.
modules.controlPolicy: Presentation only. Expanding or collapsing analysis never changes a recommendation.

modules.title: TERMINAL INTERFACE
modules.summary: Future home for additional terminal-level display preferences that should not be scattered through the runner.
modules.controlPolicy: Reserved structure only; no existing runner behavior is changed.
